subject: Stage-gate acceptance playbook & signoff pathway
body:
From: Olivia Park <olivia.park@gatewaybank.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 12 Jul 2029 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Stage-gate acceptance playbook & signoff pathway

Hi Marissa,

Thanks for the quick demo yesterday — GateBank is excited about Redwood. To make sure procurement and security can sign off on our pilot, I attached a first-pass MAP workbook and our procurement checklist.

High level asks from our side:
- SOC 2: we need the most recent SOC 2 Type II report (or SOC 2 bridge) plus scope statement (which services are in scope).
- SIG/CAIQ: a completed questionnaire or an intake matrix we can map to our vendor risk tool.
- DPA: a redline or proposed DPA; we have a few standard annex points around data retention and subprocessor notice.
- Retention: explicit retention windows for embeddings, logs, and artifacts plus deletion/archival process.

Can you propose a signoff timeline and owners for each of the bullets above? Our target is a POC kickoff 6 weeks from today (week of 8/26). If we can lock acceptance criteria and evidence dates earlier, we can fast-track procurement.

Attachments: GateBank_MAP_v1.xlsx; SIG-answers-GateBank.pdf

Thanks,
Olivia Park
Sr. Vendor Manager | GateBank
olivia.park@gatewaybank.com

---
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Olivia Park <olivia.park@gatewaybank.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 12 Jul 2029 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Stage-gate acceptance playbook & signoff pathway

Hi Olivia — thanks for the clear list and the MAP workbook. I reviewed the attached and sketched an internal acceptance path to meet GateBank's 8/26 target. Summary below, owners assigned.

Summary timeline (high level)
- Week 1 (7/15–7/19): Confirm SOC 2 scope & plan evidence intake (owner: Ben)
- Week 2 (7/22–7/26): Complete SIG/CAIQ intake + gap notes (owner: Rachel)
- Week 3 (7/29–8/2): DPA redline exchange and retention annex (owner: Legal via me)
- Week 4–5 (8/5–8/16): Evidence submission (SOC 2 artifacts, CAIQ evidence, retention policy)
- Week 6 (8/19–8/23): Acceptance review & exec signoff — ready to start POC 8/26

Acceptance criteria (proposed)
- SOC 2: Type II in last 12 months or a scoped bridge + evidence of control operating (audit logos omitted for public doc).
- SIG/CAIQ: Completed answers for all high/medium questions flagged in your intake; mitigating controls for any gaps documented.
- DPA: Agreement on retention windows for embeddings and logs (see suggested defaults below) and a mutual backup/restore clause.
- Retention defaults (Redwood default proposal): Embeddings 30 days ephemeral unless customer opts-in to longer; Logs (for debugging/ops) 90 days; Model training telemetry not stored by default.

Next steps for GateBank: please confirm the MAP milestones in the workbook and confirm whether your security team requires full CAIQ answers or a prioritized subset. Once we have that, we will populate the shared Drive link with requested evidence.

I'll loop Legal once GateBank flags DPA exceptions. Ben — can you confirm SOC 2 artifacts availability by 7/19? Rachel — can you take point on CAIQ intake?

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Director | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

Attachment: GateBank_MAP_v1.xlsx referenced

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Olivia Park <olivia.park@gatewaybank.com>
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 12 Jul 2029 12:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Stage-gate acceptance playbook & signoff pathway

Marissa / Olivia — quick update from the security intake perspective. I pulled together a lightweight evidence checklist (attached) that maps GateBank MAP items to our internal artifacts.

What I can commit to by 7/19:
- SOC 2 Type II report (redacted) and the SOC 2 scope memo
- System architecture diagram + subservice provider list
- Log retention and deletion procedure doc (ops runbook excerpt)

Open items that need GateBank confirmation:
- Are you OK with our default retention windows (Embeddings 30d / Logs 90d) or do you require longer retention for regulatory reasons? If longer, please specify by data type.
- For SIG/CAIQ: do you want the full questionnaire completed or only the 50 high-priority controls? Full CAIQ will take 7–10 business days to assemble evidence.

Attachment: evidence-checklist.csv

Ben Carter
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai

From: Olivia Park <olivia.park@gatewaybank.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.ai>, GateBank Legal <legal@gatewaybank.com>
Date: Fri, 12 Jul 2029 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Stage-gate acceptance playbook & signoff pathway

Thanks — this looks good and aligned with what we need. Two quick clarifications from our legal team:
1) Retention: GateBank requires a default 12-month retention option for embeddings when explicitly enabled by a regulated line of business; otherwise 30 days is fine.
2) DPA: our counsel will send a redline to your Legal point; can you confirm the best contact?

We do want the full SIG/CAIQ if possible — the intake PDF I shared flags a mix of high and medium controls that we use for vendor classification. If Ben needs more time, we can accept the prioritized set for initial review then complete the full CAIQ during the POC.

DocuSign: we're ready to use DocuSign for the mutual action plan once the DPA redline is agreed; please send the DocuSign link and a final MAP tab with signed owners.

Olivia Park
Sr. Vendor Manager | GateBank
